profile.bio1: I am a Full-Stack Web Developer & UI/UX Specialist driven by a passion for building fast, scalable, and intuitive digital experiences. Specializing in end-to-end development, I combine pixel-perfect visual design with robust software architecture to turn complex ideas into seamless web products.
profile.bio2: My stack spans modern web technologies including React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL. Whether engineering custom SaaS dashboards, full-stack web platforms, or interactive web tools, I build digital experiences that deliver real-world performance and aesthetic excellence.
